text:
𝗣𝗟𝗔𝗬 𝗨𝗡𝗗𝗘𝗥 𝗪𝗔𝗬! 🌧️🏏

Centurion Test: SA won the toss and bowled first after a near 4-hour rain delay.
Markram leads (Bavuma out); de Zorzi, Nortje in.

Can Bangladesh level the series? 👇
#SAvBAN #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗖𝗘𝗡𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗜𝗢𝗡 𝗠𝗘𝗜𝗡 𝗞𝗛𝗘𝗟 𝗦𝗛𝗨𝗥𝗨! 🌧️🏏

👉 Baarish ki wajah se lagbhag 4 ghante late toss hua
👉 South Africa ne toss jeeta aur pehle bowling chuni
👉 Bavuma injury se out, Markram captain; de Zorzi aur Nortje team mein
👉 Bangladesh mein Mushfiqur aur Hasan Mahmud injured

SA 1-0 se aage hai. Kya Bangladesh series barabar kar paayega? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #SAvBAN #Cricket
